claims.claim: The company’s value proposition centers on convenience, low price and a “thrill‑of‑the‑hunt” experience that drives loyalty.
claims.quote: We believe the convenience and value we offer, as well as the “thrill-of-the-hunt” shopping experience where customers discover new celebratory and seasonal items every week, are key factors in serving and growing our base of loyal customers.

claims.claim: The merchandise mix balances everyday consumables with seasonal, closeout and private‑label items to attract a broad customer base.
claims.quote: We maintain a balanced selection of products within traditional variety store categories. We offer a wide selection of everyday basic products and we supplement these with seasonal, closeout and promotional merchandise.

claims.claim: The firm operates in a highly competitive value‑retail sector and distinguishes itself by high‑value, low‑cost merchandise in attractive, conveniently located stores.
claims.quote: We believe we differentiate ourselves from other retailers by providing high-value, high-quality, low-cost merchandise in attractively-designed stores that are conveniently located.

claims.claim: The store base exceeds nine thousand U.S. locations and includes several hundred stores in Canada, each typically eight to ten thousand square feet.
claims.quote: As of January 31, 2026, we operated approximately 9,000 stores across the contiguous United States and the District of Columbia and approximately 275 stores within seven Canadian provinces, with stores predominantly ranging from 8,000 - 10,000 selling square feet.

claims.claim: Recent quarterly activity added dozens of new stores and converted hundreds to the multi‑price format.
claims.quote: Opened 84 new Dollar Tree stores during the quarter

claims.claim: Around eight hundred stores were converted or added to the multi‑price format, bringing the total to roughly seven‑four hundred multi‑price locations.
claims.quote: Converted or added approximately 800 stores to the Dollar Tree multi-price format, ending the quarter with approximately 7,400 multi-price stores

claims.claim: Management expects full‑year net sales of roughly twenty‑billion dollars and comparable store sales growth between three and four percent.
claims.quote: Net sales from continuing operations of $20.6 billion to $20.7 billion, based on comparable store net sales growth of 3.5% to 4.0%.

claims.claim: The firm is expanding its product assortment beyond the one‑and‑a‑quarter dollar price point to capture more traffic and basket size.
claims.quote: In addition to our $1.25 price point, we continue to expand our multi-price offerings to provide a broader, more relevant assortment and differentiated value to our customers.

claims.claim: New distribution centers are being built in Oklahoma and Arizona to increase capacity and reduce store‑to‑DC distance, with the Arizona site slated to open in spring 2026.
claims.quote: In October 2025, we announced the purchase of a 1.25 million square foot distribution center outside Phoenix, Arizona, expected to open in spring 2026 and service stores in Arizona, Colorado, Nevada, New Mexico, and Utah.

claims.claim: The company is executing store‑modernization projects focused on shelf productivity, refreshes and renovations to improve the customer experience and operational efficiency.
claims.quote: To achieve this, we are executing projects to optimize and modernize our stores, with a focus on improving shelf space productivity, enhancing the consistency of the in-store experience through targeted refresh and renovation programs, and supporting improved store-level performance.

claims.claim: Cost‑pressure mitigation tactics include renegotiating supplier terms, re‑engineering products and selective price adjustments to protect margins.
claims.quote: We are actively implementing mitigation strategies to offset the impact of cost pressures and inflation, including tariffs, by re‑negotiating supplier terms, re‑engineering products for efficiency, shifting country of origin where it adds advantage, discontinuing lower‑margin or underperforming items and executing targeted retail price changes.

claims.claim: Online and on‑demand delivery partnerships with Instacart and Uber Eats extend the store footprint to customers who prefer home delivery.
claims.quote: Through a partnership with Instacart, our customers can shop online and receive same‑day delivery from more than 8,400 Dollar Tree stores, as of January 31, 2026, without having to visit a store.

claims.claim: Tariff volatility remains a material risk; the company has highlighted uncertainty surrounding new tariffs and potential refunds, which could affect product costs and availability.
claims.quote: On February 20, 2026, the Supreme Court ruled that certain of the tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (“IEEPA”) were unlawful.

claims.claim: Judgment: Accelerating the commissioning of the Arizona distribution center and closely monitoring its ramp‑up schedule would mitigate supply‑chain constraints and support the planned 400 new store openings in fiscal 2026.
